name: VibeRa Synthesizer - bundled genre-first recorded and synthesized instrument

releaseBoundary.policy: Separate requested Synthesizer release gate; no RPS requirement/status/test/gate is reduced or implicitly qualified. Shared-infrastructure regressions remain mandatory.

implementationSnapshot.qualification: Source/content declaration only; no whole-module pass

requirements.name: First-class native instrument and complete host lifecycle
requirements.scope: Use the bundled native registry, instrument host/worker, Channel creation/replacement and acknowledged editor lifecycle without external VST scanning, installation, accounts, network, sample-path setup or another instrument.
acceptance: Create from the native plugin browser, open/reuse from the Rack Channel name, keep Piano Roll access separate, and retain stable Channel/plugin identities.
Exercise close/reopen, mute/delete/replace, stop and history recovery without leaked workers, stuck MIDI or permanently silent routes.
Preserve existing instrument/effect registrations and canonical automation/state/package services; an optional separately exported VST3 wrapper is not delivered or required.
requiredChecks: existing instrument lifecycle and native editor regressions

requirements.name: Original native reference-based interface and usable geometry
requirements.scope: Independently drawn interactive JUCE graphite/violet interface matching the supplied genre-first reference: branding/sidebar/search/family/favourites/preset display, macros, envelope/filter/FX areas and keyboard/pitch/mod controls.
acceptance: Inspect fresh native screenshots and actual interaction at 100% and 150% DPI, ordinary and small windows; verify resize/scrolling, focus, tooltips, readable labels and no obscured required controls.
All apparent controls operate actual instrument/browser state; preserve navigation, accessibility/contextual bindings and the active search caret.
Component renders and programmatic component checks remain distinct from scoped OS-native input; do not equate a screenshot or an instantiated editor with interactive qualification.
semanticEntryPoints: shared hosted-parameter gestures and editor service
requiredChecks: actual Synthesizer native UI/DPI acceptance TODO

requirements.name: Composable genre, instrument and preset browser
requirements.scope: Genre -> Instrument -> Preset workflow for Pop, Jazz, Funk, Hip-Hop, R&B, Electronic, Rock, Cinematic and Arabic, plus All/Favorites, search, family filtering, meaningful empty states and previous/next.
acceptance: Compose search, family, multi-genre tags and favourites consistently in native UI and MCP; use stable IDs, not list positions or display-name guesses.
Loading a filtered row, Enter, previous/next or a semantic preset request selects the same complete patch; starring does not load a sound.
Persist browser preferences/favourites independently from project Undo; reopening UI and semantic changes converge, with explicit malformed/unwritable preference failures.

requirements.name: Stable factory preset and parameter contracts
requirements.scope: Versioned metadata covers stable preset IDs, display names, thirteen instrument families, multiple genre/descriptive tags, sample/synthesis/hybrid source, engine/effects settings and meaningful per-preset macro mappings.
acceptance: Audit all 56 declared factory patches and 46 parameter IDs/keys/ranges/units/defaults against actual registry-derived UI/MCP discovery; source presence is not execution evidence.
Preserve preset/parameter IDs and schema compatibility through save/reopen and user presets; full preset load differs explicitly from changing the raw sound-source identity scalar.
Every recorded-source claim resolves to a real bundled map; genre tags do not claim cultural origin, alternate tuning or an acoustic instrument absent from the recordings.

requirements.name: Redistributable recorded content and movable installation
requirements.scope: Retain the actual 20 instrument maps/123 original WAV/FLAC files with per-file provenance, licenses and credits; resolve Content/Synthesizer relative to the executable, with writable user data separate.
acceptance: Verify all sample/map/license hashes, 10 explicit authored guitar loops and source offset/tuning conversion; preserve acquisition failures and original source notices.
Move the complete built/staged/final folder and run offline without checkout access, custom sample paths, network or accounts; missing/corrupt content produces a truthful recoverable failure.
Audit all three licensePath entries, attributions and installation-relative notice links in actual packaged Content/Synthesizer/sources; asset-only changes must refresh target content.
semanticEntryPoints: vibera_synth list/status and canonical instrument preparation errors

requirements.name: Recorded sample engine, layers and explicit mapping behavior
requirements.scope: Actual recorded sample playback uses validated key/velocity zones, MIDI roots, tuning, offsets, interpolation, per-voice ADSR/filtering and source-authored smooth loop behavior.
acceptance: Measure recorded PCM identity/variation, transposition/pitch, duration, velocity boundaries, interpolation and loop boundaries over relevant keys/rates/buffers; no substitute generated acoustic tones.
Keep layered velocity, articulation and relevant round-robin metadata/selection requirements visible; a first-round-robin-only curated subset is not proof of full round-robin or articulation support.
Do not invent loops or sustain unavailable finite recordings, label unsupported mappings explicitly, and preserve immutable sample ownership until all dependent voices finish.

requirements.name: Independent anti-aliased synthesis and real hybrid layering
requirements.scope: Deliver bounded anti-aliased oscillator synthesis and an actual recorded/synthesis layer, with truthful sample/synthesis/hybrid identity and editable source/oscillator controls.
acceptance: Measure oscillator pitch, waveform/range/detune/pulse-width behavior and high-frequency alias suppression across supported notes/sample rates.
Verify both components of the declared hybrid patch contribute actual PCM, with source/blend/sample-level/filter-envelope controls producing independent expected changes.
Never describe oscillator approximations as sampled acoustic instruments or a hardware FM-keyboard recording as an electromechanical electric piano.

requirements.name: Polyphony, sustain, expression and guaranteed note release
requirements.scope: Bounded voice allocation/stealing, sustain pedal, pitch bend/range, modulation/vibrato, note-off/all-off/panic and repeat-note behavior work with actual editor, score and live MIDI ownership.
acceptance: Measure velocity, sustain/release, overlapping/repeated notes, exhausted polyphony and voice stealing; prevent stuck notes and persistent silence.
Release held editor notes and centre pitch/end gestures on mouse-capture loss, focus loss, hide/close, transport stop, Channel mute/delete/replace and relevant Undo.
Distinguish preview-lane panic from transport/global panic; validate queue limits, rapid input and stale ownership without callback locks or allocation.
semanticEntryPoints: canonical transport, Channel and MIDI/controller operations

requirements.name: Four meaningful macros, envelopes and filters
requirements.scope: Tone, Warmth, Space and Motion have per-preset sonic mappings; ADSR, filter type/cutoff/resonance, modulation and source/performance controls operate actual DSP.
acceptance: Test each macro and mapping at relevant endpoints and intermediate values, with parameter readback, independent PCM consequences and appropriate smoothing.
Verify ADSR timing/sustain/release, per-voice filter behavior and expressive control interaction; UI/MCP share native units, ranges, defaults and interval validation.
Warmth's actual low-EQ/output-trim behavior is labelled accurately; enabled controls cannot be decorative or silently unrelated to the sound.

requirements.name: Single owned effects chain, metering and output headroom
requirements.scope: Functional independent EQ, compressor, chorus, delay and reverb enable/settings, with actual signal order, master level, output/activity metering and honest tail behavior.
acceptance: Exercise each enable/disable and settings page through UI/MCP with independent PCM or signal oracles, safe levels, stable state/history and sample-rate/buffer changes.
Measure headroom/overload behavior, decay/delay/feedback and supported tails; retain the existing project/export cut-tail contract instead of inventing an arbitrary-tail guarantee.
Use one owned native chain; do not create hidden external effect instances or silently double-apply the instrument effects.

requirements.name: Shared manual, timed automation and exact parameter history
requirements.scope: All sound controls use canonical hosted/native parameter IDs, gestures, real current readback, validation and appropriate Undo/Redo, with supported sample-timed automation.
acceptance: Verify manual and UI edits, discrete changes, automation/controller playback and simultaneous sound controls with exact values and independent PCM expectations.
Confirm instance/catalogue-generation guards and atomic no-op/refusal behavior; invalidate stale automation identities and never claim a cached catalogue value is instantaneous DSP.
Complete patch loads and scalar edits produce the intended history edges; cancellation/refusal leaves exact prior musical/native state.

requirements.name: Writable user presets and immutable factory sounds
requirements.scope: Versioned user presets save/load current native sound safely in AppData while factory definitions and recordings stay immutable; browser preferences remain distinct from musical document history.
acceptance: Use asynchronous native file pickers and semantic save/load with actual terminal success/failure/cancellation; overwrite/atomic replacement preserves a prior valid file on failure.
Round-trip every relevant scalar, preset source identity, engine/effects/macros and schema; reject malformed/oversized/unsupported files and unsafe names/paths.
Verify actual user-directory isolation, immutable factory hashes, fresh load/readback and appropriate one-step Undo/Redo; never write test data into user presets or factory content.

requirements.name: Realtime safety and bounded preset/resource publication
requirements.scope: No file I/O/decoding, allocation, blocking locks/waits, UI calls or object destruction in DSP; prepare immutable resources offthread and publish/retire them with proven lifetime safety.
acceptance: Instrument actual callbacks for heap/destruction/lock violations and outer-device deadlines across supported rates/buffers, voices, effects and source changes.
Exercise rapid repeated/cancelled preset operations and safe publication; define held-voice and accepted bounded structural interruption/recovery policies explicitly.
Preserve recording integrity, exact state/history and automatic recovery during supported structural operations; no worker cleanup or resource destruction in the callback.
semanticEntryPoints: shared plugin/native-patch jobs, cancellation and diagnostics

requirements.name: Complete Rack, Piano Roll, Pattern and Song musical integration
requirements.scope: Compose with the native synth in a real multi-instrument/multi-Pattern project: Rack and Piano Roll editing, live MIDI, Pattern/Song transport, mute/solo, Mixer routing and automation.
acceptance: Exercise held notes, repeated transport changes, linked Pattern placements, musical edits and multiple native instances without lost notes, data loss or shared-state contamination.
Verify actual channel/master routing and effects, muting/solo restoration and recovery around instrument replacement/deletion/history.
Use audible-signal/PCM, state, identity and history oracles from the complete musical workflow; preserve every existing RPS checklist item and active correctness regression.

requirements.name: Project persistence, migration, Undo and offline sound
requirements.scope: Current native sample/synthesis/hybrid settings, effects, automation and supported instrument identity survive save/reopen, migration, Undo/Redo and offline export.
acceptance: Capture actual current native state before project save/export rather than stale serialized defaults; verify exact recalled scalars and deterministic signal where applicable.
Compare actual recorded/synthesis/hybrid WAV output before/after save/reopen and history, including duration, channels/rate/format, headroom and the declared tail contract.
Retain missing/corrupt content placeholders/errors, stable IDs/routing/links, and untouched user work on failed/cancelled saves or history operations.

requirements.name: Truthful errors, cancellation and recovery
requirements.scope: Typed failures and real async outcomes cover missing/corrupt content, wrong schema/source IDs, stale instances/generations, invalid ranges, busy/capacity/recording refusals and I/O failures.
acceptance: No unsupported operation, silent acoustic fallback, queued admission or file-exists check becomes a successful completed instrument operation.
Prove late ACK/error/cancel ordering, exact cancellation/history behavior and bounded retry/recovery with current instance/project identity.
Close only owned task/runtime workers, preserve factory/user data and prior state, and retain diagnostic failure receipts; internal unfinished work is not an external blocker.
semanticEntryPoints: vibera_plugin job/cancel and canonical command outcomes

requirements.name: Complete changed-feature semantic MCP equivalence
requirements.scope: Every functional Synthesizer UI operation has discoverable typed semantic equivalence through the shared registry/canonical services: browser, sound controls, preset/user files, preview, lifecycle and history.
acceptance: Audit native component IDs/handlers and all 46 controls against actual executable discovery, units/ranges/defaults/prerequisites and current readback.

Exercise UI/MCP equivalence for filters/favourites/preset navigation, complete patch load, macros/envelopes/filters/FX/source/performance, keyboard/pitch/mod, user-file operations and editor lifecycle.
Cover queue/error/no-op/cancel/history and real completion; generic setters or screen-only input alone do not qualify missing domain operations.

requirements.name: Inventory, coverage evidence and provider-neutral skill
requirements.scope: Synchronize the reusable skill and authoritative registry-derived capabilities; enumerate every new command/control/custom surface and bind meaningful current UI/MCP review receipts.
acceptance: Update SURFACE_INVENTORY, REVIEWED_SURFACES and changed-feature coverage records from actual handlers/registry; source or an unbound review is not coverage evidence.

Audit user-facing previous/next, octave controls, file pickers/overwrite/cancel, sustain/panic scope, effect panels and dynamic parameter surfaces for explicit supported equivalence or an unresolved gap.
Keep unrelated inherited full-MCP consolidation honestly failing/deferred; qualify every new/changed feature without deleting inherited inventory/tests or claiming full product coverage.
semanticEntryPoints: registry-derived discovery and synchronized skill workflows

requirements.name: Complete current-source software qualification
requirements.scope: All preceding software workflows require actual current affected tests, source regressions and evidence-bound native UI/MCP/musical acceptance; no scoped test pass defines module completion.
acceptance: Run recorded and synthesized PCM, pitch/duration/velocity/sustain/steal/stuck-note, source-switch-during-playback, effects/tails, history/save/export and error/cancel scenarios.
Inspect fresh native captures and actual scoped input at 100%/150% DPI, test small-screen/focus/scroll/keyboard behavior, and distinguish those from component-only renders.

Retain original failed attempts; bind passed receipts to all exercised dependencies/assets and exact candidate app/worker bytes. Rerun affected cases after input changes and broader regressions after shared-infrastructure changes.

requirements.name: Exact staged/final package and separate Synthesizer release boundary
requirements.scope: After complete module software acceptance, qualify exact committed source, staged and final installation-relative content/license/skill/binary identities before updating the sole permanent distribution.
acceptance: Pass the full Synthesizer candidate ledger, exact source gate, complete required staging/final package checks, moved-folder playback and integrity/provenance audits.
Preserve the qualified distribution until its replacement passes; no separate permanent preview, hidden download/install step, optional wrapper claim or partial release shortcut.

The user-requested Synthesizer release boundary is separate from RPS; do not edit, reduce, waive or mark complete any Rack/Pattern/sampler requirement. Shared-source regressions and truthful disclosure of included RPS work remain mandatory.
semanticEntryPoints: qualified executable discovery and installed source/content behavior

externalAcceptance.name: Human listening, musical timbre/quality and mix suitability
Physical audio/MIDI devices and mixed-monitor/DPI hardware
Human familiarity with the supplied reference and musical workflow

developmentEvidence.scope: Root reports the affected pure-engine check passed in0.84s; processor compilation and remaining integration/native/MCP/source/package acceptance are pending at ledger creation.
developmentEvidence.note: Attach actual current receipt and identities before using any result as requirement evidence. Asset validation is separately scoped content evidence, not instrument/module qualification.

developmentEvidence.scope: Source208/208; native132/194; six musical workflows; MCP491; moved655; staging84 resumed with unchanged passed inputs; final117; cleanup/audit passed.

semanticInventory.note: 18 current callbacks/76 explicit operations; inherited full-product gate remains false. All actual source/native/package outcomes retained.

evidencePolicy.candidateIdentity: Exact current app/worker runtime bytes; no source-only or cached-binary acceptance.
evidencePolicy.dependencyIdentity: Bind all actual exercised source/tests/registry/content files and notices. A manifest hash alone does not bind later-mutated sample bytes.
evidencePolicy.completion: Every releaseRequired software row must be verified with sufficient current passed evidence. Release-phase row is additionally mandatory at complete/staging/final release.
evidencePolicy.historicalFailures: Retain failed, cancelled, stale and environment-blocked receipts. No retry or reduced subset relabels an original failure.

nextAction: Native Synthesizer software delivery qualified. Retain sound-content/listening/hardware/familiarity gaps; resume the separate incomplete Rack/Pattern/sampler roadmap.
